Flat White.name: Flat White
Flat White.description: Two ristretto shots under a thin layer of steamed milk. Strong, smooth, no foam to speak of.
Flat White.recipeNotes: 18g in, 36g out, 25-28 seconds. Milk to 60°C, no higher.

steps.text: Grind and dose 18g into the double basket. Level, then tamp flat.
Pull two ristretto shots into a 6oz cup — 36g out in 25-28 seconds.
Steam 130ml whole milk to 60°C. Stretch for two seconds only, then drop the tip in to spin it smooth.
Pour from height to break through the crema, then drop close and finish with a small dot in the centre.

Homemade Lemonade.name: Homemade Lemonade
Homemade Lemonade.description: Pressed lemons, cane sugar and soda water over ice, with mint from the windowsill.
Homemade Lemonade.ingredients: Lemon juice, cane sugar syrup, soda water, mint
Homemade Lemonade.recipeNotes: Syrup is 1:1 sugar to water — batch is in the fridge, marked with the date.

steps.text: Fill a highball with ice to the brim.
Add 40ml fresh lemon juice and 30ml sugar syrup.
Top with soda water, stir once from the bottom, and add a clapped mint sprig.

Test Earl Grey.name: Test Earl Grey
Test Earl Grey.description: Black tea with bergamot. Served as a pot with a jug of milk on the side.

steps.text: Warm the pot with a splash of hot water, then tip it out.
One heaped teaspoon of leaf per pot. Fill with 95°C water.
Serve with the timer card set to 4 minutes and a small jug of cold milk.
